## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (presigned-URL refresher for S3-backed attachments) — re-presigns any S3 attachment whose last presign is older than 4 days (URLs expire at 5 days), on a `time.Ticker` of **12 h** (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, loop at `:29-41`, work at `:47-132`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed at `server/server.go:162`, one immediate `RunOnce(ctx)` at `server/server.go:163`, then the goroutine `s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)` at `server/server.go:166-171` (called from `Server.Start`, `server/server.go:129`).

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual send at `safeClient.Do(req)`, `:152`); it runs on 4 background workers draining `asyncPostQueue` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55`), fed by `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`). Protection: the shared client's custom `DialContext = safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-37`, `:59-77`), which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs at dial time (defeats DNS rebinding), using `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`; additionally `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83`) rejects non-http(s)/private-resolving URLs at configuration time (called from the user-webhook RPCs, e.g. `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go`). Escape hatch: `AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`), only set in tests.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3-8`, `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, the common user-info shape the API layer consumes). Concrete implementation shipped: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20-45` `IdentityProvider`/`NewIdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`, `UserInfo`) — OAuth2/OIDC-style is the only protocol implementation; it is instantiated in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go` and `idp_service.go`.

**h04** — **No.** Evidence: the only import of `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` in the whole module is `store/db/db.go:8`, and the only call to `mysql.NewDB` is the factory switch at `store/db/db.go:22`. Inside the package itself the struct is only literal-constructed in a unit test (`store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`, `db := &DB{}`); `NewDB` itself is at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`.

**h05** — Mechanism: **explicit Go code**, inside the per-driver `DeleteUser` transaction — two deletes: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions *on* the user's memos, keyed by `content_id = "memos/<uid>"`) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions *made by* the user). Sites: `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:95-104` (helpers at `:355-374` and `:376-379`), `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102` (helpers `:417`, `:437`), `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102` (helpers `:380`, `:400`); entry `Store.DeleteUser` → `driver.DeleteUser` (`store/user.go:170-180`). Checked and ruled out a DB-level rule: the `reaction` table has no FK/cascade (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:91-99`, same in postgres/mysql `LATEST.sql`); the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schema is `memo_share.memo_id → memo(id)` (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql:108-109`).

**h06** — Handlers (all `APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `:513`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `:119`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`; `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48` (both via `memo_update_helpers.go:66-67`)

Convergence before delivery: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, whose queue workers call `Post`).

**h07** — `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` (route registered `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`; the URL is minted in `server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`):
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getCurrentUser` (only when instance disallows anonymous) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:706` (→ `auth.Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser`, `server/auth/authenticator.go`)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` (checks `userCache` only on ID lookups; here it falls through) — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `Driver.ListUsers` interface hop — `store/driver.go:47`
- `sqlite.(*DB).ListUsers` (default driver) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`
- Then `parseDataURI` decodes the stored base64 `user.avatar_url` and serves the blob — `fileserver.go:196-209`

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked** — callers: `server/server.go:163` (startup) and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (ticker loop).
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** — no callers in production or test code (grep for `RunOnce` yields only the two s3presign call sites); only the package-level `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**h09** — Count: **6** concrete non-test declarations (plus the `Close() error` method on the `store.Driver` interface at `store/driver.go:12`, and 2 test-only helpers in `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`):
`SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`), `cache.Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `sqlite.(*DB).Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `postgres.(*DB).Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `mysql.(*DB).Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`).
Invoked from non-test server code:
- `SSEHub.Close` ← `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `Store.Close` ← `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `cache.Cache.Close` ← `store/store.go:74-76` (three cache instances)
- driver `Close` ← `store/store.go:78` (`s.driver.Close()`), dispatching to sqlite/postgres/mysql — sqlite on a default install.

**h10** — `(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — approx **38 call sites** repo-wide (7 of them non-test: `internal/filter/helpers.go:11`, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:356`, `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:85`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go:87,98`, `store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go:78`). Runners-up: `filter.NewEngine` ~33, `filter.NewSchema` ~30, `(*render).addArg` 28 (all intra-package), `util.GenUUID` 28 (`internal/util/util.go:40`).

**h11** — 1st: **`store.User`** (`store/user.go:29`) — referenced from ~7 packages outside the store layer (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`). 2nd: **`store.Memo`** (`store/memo.go`) — ~6 packages (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`). (Next: `store.Attachment` ~4; `store.Inbox`/`store.MemoRelation`/`store.MemoShare` ~3.)

**h12** — Concrete method: `sqlite.(*DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (the `INSERT INTO memo (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ...` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-42`). Determination: the driver is chosen by `profile.Driver`, whose default is `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` `viper.SetDefault("driver","sqlite")`, flag default `cmd/memos/main.go:130`); `db.NewDBDriver` switches on it and calls `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/db.go:19-20`, `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:24`), whose `*DB` is stored as the single `store.Driver` in `Store` (`store/store.go:14`, `store/store.go:36-58`); `Store.CreateMemo` just delegates: `return s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` (`store/memo.go:113`), reached from `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`). The mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` implementations are unreachable without `--driver`.

**h13** — Implementation: the unexported `markdown.service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`), the only implementer of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-56`); no other production or test implementation exists. Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` in `NewAPIV1Service` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` (test rig mirrors it at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`). Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` / the `RebuildMemoPayload` parameter (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16,19,74`).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which delegates to `(*markdown.service).ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-416`. Triggers: memo create (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and memo update when content changes (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`); a bulk backfill path also exists in `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52`) but nothing calls it. Extracted: `Payload.Tags` (all `#tag` nodes not inside links/images) and `Payload.Property` — `Title` (text of a leading H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode` (code block/fenced/span), `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:376-405`; fields at `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:87-90`). `Mentions` is also returned by `ExtractAll` but is consumed separately (`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), not stored in the payload.

**h15** — Distinct enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read gate; archived + non-public) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`, called from `GetMemo` (`:356`, parent at `:367`) and `ListMemoComments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`)
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` query-scoping (`VisibilityList` / CEL `visibility in [...]` filter) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoReactions` inline check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-41`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemoAttachments` inline check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-225`
- User-stats query scoping — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:77-92` and `:214-222`
- SSE fan-out filter `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143` (event visibility set in `sse_event_helpers.go:29-37`)
- File server `checkAttachmentPermission` (public + anonymous-allowed, share-token fallback, private→creator/admin) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-704`
- RSS feeds restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Frontend sitemap restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Share-token path that deliberately bypasses visibility for a valid, unexpired token — `server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:137` and `:200`

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the repo (no redis import, dependency, or config; grep over Go sources and `go.mod` returns nothing). Caching is an in-process, per-instance map cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` with `sync.Map`, TTL sweep goroutine `cleanupLoop`, `store/cache/cache.go:66-89`). `Store` holds three of them — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` (`store/store.go:26-29`) — all built with the same config in `store.New`: **DefaultTTL 10 minutes**, CleanupInterval 5 minutes, MaxItems 1000 (`store/store.go:38-43`). So user entries expire 10 minutes after write; they are also written on create/update/list/get (`store/user.go:91,122,132,143,166`) and explicitly evicted on delete (`store/user_delete.go:39-47`).

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware, per-user or otherwise. The only Echo middleware registered is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`), plus static/SPA-fallback in the frontend service (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54,59`); the API layer's interceptors are auth/authorization only (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`, `authz.go`, `NewAuthorizer` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66-70`). A grep for `rate limit`/`ratelimit` across the Go sources hits only a comment in `internal/email/doc.go:86`. The only throttling in the codebase is concurrency limiting via semaphores (thumbnails/image processing: `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:60-61`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:116`) and the bounded webhook queue (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`).

**r03** — Premise is wrong: there is no nightly database-cleanup job, and no cron scheduler is running. `internal/scheduler` is a standalone, fully unwired package — it is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`); no production code calls `scheduler.New`/`Register`/`Start`. The `"0 2 * * *"` daily-cleanup expression appears only as documentation/example text (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:16`, `internal/scheduler/README.md`). The only real scheduled background work is the 12-hour S3 presign ticker (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, started at `server/server.go:166-171`).

**r04** — Premise is wrong: there is no message broker at all — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (nor AMQP/Kafka/Redis) appears in the Go sources or `go.mod`. Webhook delivery is in-process: a buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue` with capacity 128 (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `func init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `Post` (`:120`). Producers call `PostAsync` (`:184`), which drops the event with a warning when the buffer is full (`:189-195`) — so delivery is best-effort, not durable, and the queue does not survive a restart.

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema, server, or dependency in the repo. The public API is defined as **Protocol Buffers** under `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (generated Go in `proto/gen/api/v1/`), exposed three ways from `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64+`): Connect RPC handlers (`server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:31+`, `connect_services.go`), a gRPC-Gateway JSON/REST mapping, plus an SSE stream (`sse_handler.go`). Alongside it are non-RPC HTTP surfaces: the file server `/file/...` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), the MCP server (`server/router/mcp/service.go`, registered `server/server.go:92-96`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:67`).
